info.name: FixFlow API - Assignment 2 (241854)
info.description:
Executable acceptance tests for FixFlow (NestJS). Abdul Raheem, 241854.

Run against a FRESHLY STARTED API (npm start loads the seed), in order, with the FixFlow environment.
Set `expiredToken` first: `npm run -s token:expired`.

CLI: npm run test:postman  (or: npx newman run postman/FixFlow.postman_collection.json -e postman/FixFlow.postman_environment.json --env-var expiredToken=<token>)

item.description: OPEN -> ASSIGNED -> IN_PROGRESS -> RESOLVED -> CLOSED, then feedback and dashboard counts.

exec: pm.test("Success is wrapped as { success, data, requestId }", () => {
pm.test("Server sets status OPEN, owner and no assignment", () => { pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("OPEN"); pm.expect(r.requesterId).to.eql(4); pm.expect(r.assignedTechnicianId).to.eql(null); });
pm.test("Status ASSIGNED to technician 5", () => { const r = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("ASSIGNED"); pm.expect(r.assignedTechnicianId).to.eql(5); });

item.name: Reject a resolution note under 20 characters (400)

exec: pm.test("RESOLVED by Bilal", () => { const r = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("RESOLVED"); pm.expect(r.resolvedByTechnicianId).to.eql(5); });

item.name: Details: request, assignment and chronological history

exec: pm.test("History has every step in order", () => pm.expect(d.history.map((h) => h.toStatus)).to.eql(["OPEN", "ASSIGNED", "IN_PROGRESS", "RESOLVED", "CLOSED"]));
pm.test("Each event has old status, new status, actor and time", () => d.history.forEach((h) => { pm.expect(h).to.have.keys("id", "requestId", "fromStatus", "toStatus", "actorId", "note", "at"); }));
pm.test("Assignment and feedback are included", () => { pm.expect(d.assignment.technicianId).to.eql(5); pm.expect(d.feedback.rating).to.eql(5); });

pm.test("Role REQUESTER with counts by status", () => { pm.expect(d.role).to.eql("REQUESTER"); pm.expect(d.byStatus.CLOSED).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(d.byStatus).to.have.all.keys("OPEN", "ASSIGNED", "IN_PROGRESS", "RESOLVED", "CLOSED", "CANCELLED"); });

item.name: Dispatcher dashboard: by status, by category, per technician

exec: pm.test("byStatus adds up to the total", () => pm.expect(Object.values(d.byStatus).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)).to.eql(d.totalRequests));

item.name: History retained, previous assignment marked cleared

exec: pm.test("Old assignment kept with cleared time and reason", () => { pm.expect(d.assignmentHistory[0].technicianId).to.eql(7); pm.expect(d.assignmentHistory[0].clearedAt).to.not.eql(null); });

item.name: S9 Search, filters, pagination, categories
item.description: Combined filters, scoping before totals, pagination, category deactivation.

exec: pm.test("Every item matches all filters", () => d.items.forEach((r) => { pm.expect(r.title.toLowerCase()).to.include("projector"); pm.expect(r.categoryId).to.eql(3); pm.expect(r.status).to.eql("OPEN"); pm.expect(r.priority).to.eql("HIGH"); }));

item.name: Requester totals count only their own records

exec: pm.test("page 2, limit 3, at most 3 items", () => { pm.expect(d.page).to.eql(2); pm.expect(d.limit).to.eql(3); pm.expect(d.items.length).to.be.at.most(3); pm.expect(d.totalPages).to.eql(Math.ceil(d.total / 3)); });
pm.test("Sorted newest first", () => { const t = d.items.map((r) => r.createdAt); pm.expect(t).to.eql([...t].sort().reverse()); });
pm.test("page 1 / limit 10", () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.limit).to.eql(10); pm.expect(d.items.length).to.be.at.most(10); });

pm.test("Seeded categories present, inactive HVAC hidden", () => { const n = pm.response.json().data.map((c) => c.name); ["Electrical", "Plumbing", "IT Support", "Furniture"].forEach((x) => pm.expect(n).to.include(x)); pm.expect(n).to.not.include("HVAC"); });
